summary: Baltic Fresh Foods Ltd. presented its operations report for the third quarter of 2026 covering the period from 1 July to 30 September 2026. Revenue reached EUR 4,850,000, while operating costs amounted to EUR 3,920,000. Northern Cold Chain AB extended its warehousing framework agreement until 2028. Additionally, capital expenditure reached USD 310,000, primarily allocated to temperature sensors and two electric vans.
keyPoints: Revenue reached EUR 4,850,000, representing a 6% increase on the previous quarter.
Operating costs for the quarter totaled EUR 3,920,000.
The migration of route planning to a new telematics platform was completed, and two legacy depots were retired.
Northern Cold Chain AB extended the framework agreement until 2028.
Capital expenditure amounted to USD 310,000 for temperature sensors and electric vans.
